en.hero.eyebrow: Paired agent benchmark · GreptimeDB Semantic Graph
en.hero.title: Does the observability interface behind the agent change root cause analysis?
en.hero.lede: Same models, same incidents, three observability interfaces: Prometheus with Loki and Tempo, GreptimeDB, and GreptimeDB with its Semantic Graph. We measured what changed: how often the root cause was found, how much work it took, and what it cost.
en.board.title: Three questions, and what the measurement supports
en.board.note: Each confirmatory family is Holm-corrected on its own. Non-significant means insufficient evidence, not equivalence.
en.question.semantic_layer: Does the complete GreptimeDB Semantic Graph interface reduce RCA investigation work while preserving diagnosis and evidence validity?
en.question.storage_shape: How does the GreptimeDB all-in-one agent-facing interface compare with a Prometheus, Loki and Tempo native interface bundle on the same incidents? The arms differ in store, query languages and tool surface together, so this is an interface-bundle comparison, not an isolated storage effect.
en.question.model_ranking: How do the models differ at RCA under each interface?
en.strip.title: Every eligible case, one point
en.strip.lede: Each dot is one incident that both interfaces diagnosed correctly. Where it sits shows what that same correct answer cost each side.
en.interface.title: Finding 1 — GreptimeDB against three backends
en.interface.lede: Both endpoints registered for this comparison measure work, not accuracy: the steps taken to reach a correct diagnosis, and the tokens the model had to read.
en.interface.rows_note: Rows returned cannot be compared here. A Prometheus sample, a Loki entry and a Tempo trace are not the same unit as a GreptimeDB row, so this endpoint reports N/A instead of zero.
en.semantic.title: Finding 2 — what the GreptimeDB Semantic Graph changed
en.semantic.lede: Both arms read the same telemetry from the same GreptimeDB instance. The Semantic Graph is the only difference. The registered endpoints are the steps taken to reach a correct diagnosis and the rows the queries returned.
en.semantic.reversal_lede: Correct diagnoses under each interface, grouped by the level the fault sat at.
en.diagnosis.title: Did the interface change how often the diagnosis was right?
en.diagnosis.lede: Out of {runs} runs per model and interface. Descriptive only: diagnosis accuracy is not a registered endpoint.
en.cost.title: What each interface actually cost to run
en.cost.lede: Every executed run in the treatment, including runs that failed. Currencies are never converted.
en.retrieval.title: Retrieval got cheaper. Investigations did not.
en.retrieval.lede: Discovery asks the model to find the table and signal that carry the evidence. Graph retrieval starts from a known anomalous signal and asks for the correct direct dependency. Both stop at the evidence query, so these numbers do not compare with the end-to-end ones.
en.models.title: How the models differed
en.models.score_note: A descriptive index computed after the measurement, out of {max} points split {split} between location, root cause and executed evidence. Scores are normalised to 100 over each model's {runs} end-to-end runs, with failed runs left in the denominator. It is not a registered endpoint and carries no significance test.
en.cases.title: Cases and per-case outcomes
en.cases.lede: The agent sees an opaque case id and nothing else. Mechanisms and targets appear in this report, never in the prompt.
en.resources.title: Tokens, cost, and reliability
en.resources.lede: Input counts every token the provider charged for reading. Reasoning is part of output, not an addition to it.
en.method.title: Method and limits
en.method.evidence_note: The deterministic verifier reads SQL. It is published as a separate audit and does not decide headline eligibility.
en.glossary.run.def: One model, one incident, one interface, one repetition.
en.glossary.arms.def: Three backends through their own APIs; GreptimeDB over read-only SQL; that same GreptimeDB with the Semantic Graph added.
en.glossary.eligible.def: A paired case where both compared arms reached a correct diagnosis with an execution-valid citation and a reliable run.
en.glossary.median.def: Repetition deltas are reduced to one median per model and case before any cross-case summary.
en.glossary.delta.def: The comparison named in the heading. A negative delta means the interface named first did less.
en.glossary.holm.def: The p value after multiplicity correction within one confirmatory family.
en.glossary.na.def: Not estimable. It never means zero.
en.footer.text: Generated deterministically from two sanitized measurement artifacts. It embeds no provider payloads, raw telemetry, credentials or endpoints.
en.panel.scores: Open exact scores and the rubric
en.panel.evidence: Open evidence pairing and claim rejection codes
en.overview.title: What we found
en.overview.setup_lede: Every model investigates every incident {total} times: {repetitions} runs through each of the {interfaces} interfaces. The telemetry, the incident, the prompt and the tool budget are identical every time. Only the interface changes.
en.arm.split_pillars.name: Three backends
en.arm.split_pillars.gloss: Prometheus, Loki and Tempo, each through its own API and query language. Signals cannot be joined in one query.
en.arm.raw.name: GreptimeDB
en.arm.raw.gloss: The same metrics, logs and traces as tables in GreptimeDB, queried with read-only SQL.
en.arm.semantic_graph.name: GreptimeDB + Semantic Graph
en.arm.semantic_graph.gloss: The same GreptimeDB SQL surface, plus what each table means, which entities exist, and how the source proves they depend on each other.
en.component.telemetry: The incident's metrics, logs and traces
en.component.read-only-sql: Read-only SQL over all three signals
en.overview.evidence_note: There is one rule and it is the registered one: an endpoint counts only if it survives Holm correction within its family at the {alpha} level. Everything else on this page is descriptive. Where a case median points is recorded as a direction and nothing more; a direction is not a weaker kind of result.
en.metric.correct_completion_tool_calls.not: tool calls in a run that ended in a correct diagnosis
en.metric.rows_returned.note: rows returned by the queries the agent ran
en.metric.provider_visible_input_tokens: Tokens the model had to read
en.panel.matrix: Open the exact component list for each interface
en.panel.confound: Open the same runs split by source dataset
en.method.rejection_note: The verifier runs its mechanism check over every citation, including ones submitted as exclusion or downstream-impact evidence that never claimed to prove the mechanism. Only the first column describes an attempt that fell short; the second only shows how wide the check reaches. A code in either column does not by itself mean a claim failed, because another citation may already ground it.
en.headline.title: What changed when only the interface changed
en.headline.lede: Every bar covers the same incidents, models and budget. Ratios are against the best arm on that row.
en.headline.cost.note: lower is better; every executed run, failures included
en.headline.input_tokens: Tokens the model had to read
en.headline.input_tokens.note: lower is better; a registered endpoint
en.headline.excluded: {models} has no frozen rate and is excluded from this row.

zh.hero.eyebrow: 配对 Agent Benchmark · GreptimeDB Semantic Graph
zh.hero.title: Agent 背后的可观测性接口会改变根因分析吗？
zh.hero.lede: 同样的模型、同样的故障，换三种可观测性接口：Prometheus 加 Loki、Tempo，GreptimeDB，以及 GreptimeDB 加语义层。测三件事：根因找对了几次、调查走了多少步、一共花了多少钱。
zh.board.title: 三个问题，以及测量支持的结论
zh.board.note: 两个确认性检验族各自独立做 Holm 校正。不显著表示证据不足，不表示等价。
zh.question.semantic_layer: 完整的 GreptimeDB Semantic Graph 接口能否在保持诊断和证据有效性的前提下减少 RCA 调查工作量？
zh.question.storage_shape: 在同一批故障上，GreptimeDB 一体化 agent 接口与 Prometheus、Loki、Tempo 原生接口组合相比如何？两组同时改变了存储、查询语言和工具面，因此这是接口组合的比较，不是孤立的存储效应。
zh.question.model_ranking: 在每种接口下，各模型的 RCA 表现有何差异？
zh.strip.title: 每个合格 case 一个点
zh.strip.lede: 每个点是一个两种接口都诊断正确的故障。点的位置表示同样答对这道题，两边各花了多少。
zh.strip.signs: {eligible} 个中 {negative} 个在零线左侧
zh.interface.title: 发现 1 — GreptimeDB 对比三个后端
zh.interface.lede: 这一组的两个注册端点测的都是工作量，不是准确率：答对一次要走多少步，模型要读多少 token。
zh.interface.rows_note: 返回行数在这里没法比。Prometheus 的一个 sample、Loki 的一条 entry、Tempo 的一条 trace，和 GreptimeDB 的一行不是同一个单位，所以这个端点显示 N/A，不是 0。
zh.semantic.title: 发现 2 — GreptimeDB 语义层改变了什么
zh.semantic.lede: 两臂读的是同一个 GreptimeDB 实例里的同一份遥测，区别只有语义层。这一组注册的端点是：答对一次要走多少步，查询返回了多少行。
zh.semantic.mechanism_title: 按故障机制看返回行数
zh.semantic.reversal_lede: 按故障所在层级分组的各接口诊断正确数。
zh.diagnosis.title: 接口是否改变了诊断的正确率？
zh.diagnosis.lede: 每个模型每种接口共 {runs} 次 run。仅作描述：诊断正确率不是注册端点。
zh.cost.title: 各接口实际跑下来的成本
zh.cost.lede: 包含该 treatment 下全部执行过的 run，失败的也计入。不做币种换算。
zh.retrieval.title: 检索变省了，调查没有
zh.retrieval.lede: Discovery 要模型自己找出承载故障证据的表和信号。Graph retrieval 从一个已知的异常信号出发，要它给出正确的直接依赖。两者都算到证据查询为止，所以这些数字不能和端到端的比。
zh.models.title: 模型之间的差异
zh.models.score_note: 这是测完之后另算的描述性指数，满分 {max}，按 {split} 分给定位、根因和已执行的证据。分数在每个模型的 {runs} 次端到端 run 上归一到 100，失败的 run 也留在分母里。它不是注册端点，也不做显著性检验。
zh.cases.title: Case 与逐 case 结果
zh.cases.lede: agent 只看得到一个不透明的 case id。机制和目标只出现在这份报告里，不进 prompt。
zh.resources.title: Token、成本与可靠性
zh.resources.lede: Input 是 provider 按输入计费的全部 token。Reasoning 属于 output 的一部分，不另外相加。
zh.method.title: 方法与边界
zh.method.evidence_note: 确定性 verifier 只读 SQL。它作为独立审计发布，不决定 headline eligibility。
zh.method.tool_use: Agent 实际使用了哪些接口
zh.glossary.run.def: 一个模型 × 一个故障 × 一种接口 × 一次重复。
zh.glossary.arms.def: 三个后端各走自己的 API；GreptimeDB 走只读 SQL；同一个 GreptimeDB 再加语义层。
zh.glossary.eligible.def: 参与比较的两臂都诊断正确、引用可执行且运行可靠的配对 case。
zh.glossary.median.def: 跨 case 汇总前，先在每个模型和 case 内对重复取中位数。
zh.glossary.delta.def: 按标题给出的比较方向。负数表示排在前面的那个接口花得更少。
zh.glossary.holm.def: 在同一确认性检验族内做多重比较校正后的 p 值。
zh.th.direction: 更少 / 持平 / 更多
zh.label.join_calls: 成功的 SQL JOIN 调用
zh.label.join_runs: 含成功 JOIN 的 run
zh.label.graph_tool_runs: 调用 query_semantic_graph 的 Graph run
zh.footer.text: 本页由两份脱敏测量工件确定性生成，不含 provider payload、原始遥测行、凭据和 endpoint。
zh.panel.cost: 展开各接口成本与计价
zh.panel.scores: 展开精确分数与评分细则
zh.panel.reliability: 展开可靠性与成本合计
zh.panel.tool_calls: 展开完整工具调用明细
zh.panel.evidence: 展开证据配对与 claim 拒绝原因
zh.overview.title: 结论
zh.overview.setup_lede: 每个模型对每个故障调查 {total} 次：{interfaces} 种接口各跑 {repetitions} 次。遥测数据、故障、prompt 和工具预算每次都一样，只有接口不同。
zh.arm.split_pillars.name: 三个后端
zh.arm.split_pillars.gloss: Prometheus、Loki、Tempo 各用自己的 API 和查询语言，无法在一次查询里关联多种信号。
zh.arm.raw.name: GreptimeDB
zh.arm.raw.gloss: 同样的指标、日志、链路，在 GreptimeDB 里就是表，用只读 SQL 查。
zh.arm.semantic_graph.name: GreptimeDB + 语义层
zh.arm.semantic_graph.gloss: 同样用 GreptimeDB SQL 查，另外还知道每张表是什么、有哪些实体，以及源数据能证明的依赖关系。
zh.component.telemetry: 该故障的指标、日志与链路
zh.component.read-only-sql: 覆盖三种信号的只读 SQL
zh.overview.evidence_note: 只有一条规则，且是注册好的：端点必须在其检验族内通过 Holm 校正（{alpha} 水平）才算数。本页其余内容都是描述性的。case median 指向哪一边只记录为方向，方向不是一种较弱的结论。
zh.metric.correct_completion_tool_calls.not: 诊断正确的 run 中的工具调用次数
zh.metric.rows_returned.note: agent 执行的查询返回的行数
zh.panel.matrix: 展开各接口的完整组件清单
zh.panel.confound: 展开同一批 run 按来源数据集的拆分
zh.th.rejection_other: 被一并检查的其他引用
zh.method.rejection_note: 验证器会对每一条引用都跑机制检查，包括那些作为排除性证据或下游影响提交、本来就不声称证明机制的引用。只有第一列代表「尝试了但没做到」，第二列只反映检查覆盖了多广。任一列出现计数都不等于该 claim 失败，因为可能已有另一条引用把它证明了。
zh.grade.not_confirmed.gloss: 没有注册端点通过校正
zh.headline.title: 只换接口，结果差多少
zh.headline.lede: 每条都基于同一批故障、同样的模型和预算。倍数相对该行表现最好的那一臂。
zh.headline.cost.note: 越低越好；含全部执行过的 run，失败的也算
zh.headline.input_tokens.note: 越低越好；这是注册端点
